subject: CS toolset consolidation: recommendation, pilot asks, and renewal timing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CS toolset consolidation: kickoff + renewal dates (matrix attached)

Hi all —

Sending a short kickoff note to align on our customer support & success tooling renewals and a potential consolidation motion across Zendesk / Intercom / Gainsight. I attached a simple renewal_matrix.xlsx with contract end dates, current ARR, and rough seat counts. High level: we have three upcoming renewal events across the next 6–9 months and limited budget runway for multiple parallel renewals.

Ask: please review the matrix and reply with two things by EOD Wed: 1) your prioritization (1/2/3) for each contract to tackle, and 2) any hard constraints (team capacity, security review timing, procurement windows). I want to surface a proposed pilot to test Intercom unified inbox + routing for one segment and evaluate replacing Zendesk for Tier 1 later this quarter. Gainsight renewal touches CS workflow integrations — we should decide whether to consolidate or keep Gainsight for high-touch CSMs.

Attachments: renewal_matrix.xlsx (sheet: dates + seats)

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS toolset consolidation: kickoff + renewal dates (matrix attached)

Naomi — thanks, had a quick pass on the matrix. Prioritization from Growth/Support perspective:

- Intercom (priority 1): consolidating chat + inbox reduces latency and tooling overhead; we already have event webhooks in place.
- Zendesk (priority 2): mainly legacy tickets; replacement requires migration plan for macros and macros->flows.
- Gainsight (priority 3): keep for QBRs and churn playbooks unless we can replicate Signals cheaply.

I've attached a short savings_model.pdf that sketches the delta between 1) keep all three, 2) replace Zendesk with Intercom, and 3) full consolidation (Intercom + Gainsight replace). The model is conservative on support headcount impact.

Two quick constraints: 1) Support hiring freeze in December reduces migration bandwidth, and 2) Procurement needs 30 days for enterprise quotes. Recommend we scope a 6-week pilot for Intercom inbox on a single product vertical (US SMB) — if it hits CSAT and SLA targets we expand.

Attachments: savings_model.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Support
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Intercom Sales <intercom-sales@intercom.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS toolset consolidation: Intercom pilot outline + preliminary quote

Hi Naomi / Marissa —

Great to see the interest in a pilot. Per our quick review, Intercom can support a 6-week pilot for the US SMB vertical with unified inbox, routing rules, and the Customer Data Platform sync you referenced. Attached is a preliminary quote (Intercom-Quote-Redwood-2026.pdf) scoped for 500 MAUs and full inbox routing.

Key notes:
- Pilot price is discounted and refundable against a 12-month commitment if you decide to expand.
- We can provide an implementation resource for the pilot for an additional one-time fee (we can pair on timing to avoid the December hiring freeze).
- Security: we accept our standard SOC2 package; we can start the security questionnaire next week.

If it helps, I’m available for a 30-min call Friday to walk the pilot scope and deliverables.

Best,
Alex Turner
Enterprise Sales, Intercom
intercom-sales@intercom.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS toolset consolidation: Intercom pilot outline + preliminary quote

Thanks Alex — and Naomi / team — quick internal thoughts:

- Support: we should pilot with only the US SMB inbox and freeze any changes to macros in Zendesk during the pilot window. That reduces migration risk and keeps historical ticket access.
- Gainsight: don't cancel yet. Use the pilot to validate routing/deflection; Gainsight provides Signals and CSM workflow that would be expensive to replicate quickly. Recommendation: pilot Intercom for Tier 1 and automate some Signals export to Intercom; re-evaluate Gainsight at renewal if pilot materially reduces enterprise touch.
- Ask: can Intercom provide an export template for Signals so Gainsight -> Intercom sync is straightforward? (Alex — please confirm.)

I'm attaching a short pilot-ask.docx with the implementation checklist I think we need (who owns webhooks, who owns CSAT sampling, proposed SLOs). Also, let's book a 30-min alignment on Wed 11/11 9:30–10:00 PST to finalize pilot scope.

Attachments: pilot-ask.docx

-Rishi
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CS toolset consolidation: Intercom pilot outline + preliminary quote

Team — thanks for the quick inputs. Short summary and next steps (action items):

1) Pilot decision: APPROVED — run 6-week Intercom unified inbox pilot for US SMB starting week of 11/22. Owner: Marissa (implementation lead) + Rishi (SLOs & measurement).
2) Procurement: Vivek to initiate procurement loop and secure the discounted pilot quote; procurement needs vendor contact + quote by 11/19 to lock pilot pricing.
3) Security & Compliance: Intercom to start SOC2 questionnaire; Laura to coordinate any gaps.
4) Gainsight: keep current contract for now; evaluate after pilot (tentative re-eval 2/1/2027).
5) DocuSign: once pilot quote is final we will sign the pilot engagement; sourcing team will circulate the DocuSign link.

Please confirm you own the action items above and update the HubSpot record (link below) with any blockers. I will follow up with a calendar invite for the 11/11 alignment (reschedule if needed).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME-1001
DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC-REDWOOD-2026

Thanks —
Naomi
